zh.title: 達美航空執行長批希斯洛拆分決定「短視」誓言力抗搬離維珍航廈
zh.summary: 達美航空執行長巴斯蒂安公開批評希斯洛機場決定2028年將達美航空遷往第四航廈、與維珍大西洋航空分開，稱此舉「短視」且「對航空消費者不利」，並表示將力抗這項決定。
body: 達美航空執行長艾德·巴斯蒂安公開批評希斯洛機場（LHR）的決定。希斯洛機場計畫於2028年將達美航空遷往第四航廈，使其與維珍大西洋航空分開；巴斯蒂安稱這項決定「短視」，且「對航空消費者不利」，並表示將力抗這項安排。
希斯洛機場的決定要求達美航空於2028年遷往第四航廈。巴斯蒂安表示將力抗這項決定，批評機場方面的規劃對航空消費者不利。

en.title: Delta CEO calls Heathrow move to split airline from Virgin Atlantic "short-sighted"
en.summary: Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian has publicly criticized Heathrow Airport's decision to move the airline to Terminal 4 in 2028, calling it "short-sighted" and "bad for airline consumers," and vowed to fight the split from Virgin Atlantic.
body: Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian has gone public to criticize Heathrow Airport (LHR)'s decision to move the airline to Terminal 4 in 2028, calling the decision "short-sighted" and "bad for airline consumers." The move would split Delta from Virgin Atlantic.
Bastian vowed to fight the decision. His criticism puts Delta publicly at odds with Heathrow over the 2028 terminal allocation, with the airline arguing the split would hurt passengers.
